messages:
julia: Quick sync: noticed a breaking param rename in the v2 SDK docs that will confuse users. We show "completion_params" in examples but the v2 SDK uses "response_options" now. Saw this in the 'serverless-chat' sample.

sam: Oof. That will error at runtime. Can you paste the snippet?

julia: Sure:

julia: ```
await client.generate({ model: 'rwd/chat-v2', completion_params: { max_tokens: 200 } })
```

julia: Should be: 

julia: ```
await client.responses.create({ model: 'rwd/chat-v2', response_options: { max_tokens: 200 } })
```

sam: I'll take the examples PR. Plan: replace occurrences in docs + examples repo, add a short migration note in the SDK reference that lists param renames (completion_params -> response_options, model_alias -> model, stream_cb -> on_stream). Keep it as a small table so search works.

tony: Add a short code diff in the migration guide showing before/after. People often copy the old call sites. Also add a grep CI job in the docs pipeline to fail if old param names appear in top-level examples.

julia: Good. Also add a tiny note in the changelog and a ticket for support to update canned troubleshooting replies. Link those in the PR description.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4899 - title: "docs: sdk param rename mapping + update examples" (assignee: sam)

ci-bot: CI started for PR #4899

sam: PR includes: migration table, updated serverless-chat sample, small automated replace commit for docs only (examples PR follow-up), and a link to an examples issue to track the sweep.

ci-bot: CI passed for PR #4899

julia: Merged. Filed examples sweep issue and assigned to @sam for follow-up. Thanks all.
